I pulled an Apple II Plus out of my parents attic. Now what?

I remember a game called Drol (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Drol). I played it a lot.

I had inherited the Apple II+ from my grandfather who had upgraded to an IBM AT with a (gasp!) 20MB hard drive. I was a tinkerer with the computer and was always messing with different programs I'd find in Compute! or BYTE magazines. One program I typed in via assembly language (6502 yay!) would allow you to view and alter the bytes on a floppy disk. While messing around with that program I inadvertently overwrote a good part of the floppy that had Drol on it. Bye Drol!
Find the old floppies of Wizardry and Ultima II, and have fun!
